generations.name: First generation (27 kWh)
generations.notes: 27 kWh usable (30.5 gross) pack, CHAdeMO DC (Wikipedia says up to 100 kW; real peak to be researched), 6.6 kW AC. Rated 149-150 km both markets. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kia_Soul_EV

generations.name: 2018 update (30 kWh)
generations.notes: Eight cells added: 30 kWh usable (31.8 gross); both regulators' range rises to 179 km. Same CHAdeMO port. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kia_Soul_EV

generations.name: Second generation
generations.notes: New Soul EV on Kona Electric hardware: CCS DC, 39.2 kWh (NRCan "120 Ah", Canada EV Premium) or 64 kWh (NRCan "180 Ah", EV Limited). Canada 2020-2023. EPA rated a 2020 US car (243 mi) but Kia never sold it in the US (reports say the rating was retracted): that EPA row is a not-sold candidate for the owner. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.kia.ca/content/dam/marketing/content/vehicles/brochures/2022/soul-ev/MY22_Soul_EV_ENG.pdf ; https://www.thedrive.com/news/35265/the-kia-soul-ev-isnt-coming-to-the-us-and-that-sorta-stinks-report
